AiSource.description: Where a recommendation came from: the model, its saved answer, or a fixed rule (R22).

Alternative.description: Room for more premium in one cover of the plan.

can_take.description: The most extra premium the cover can take this period.

exposure.description: What makes the extra cover usable: declaring it (a trip, a ticket, a device).

Exposure.description:
What a customer must have for a cover to protect them this policy period. The optimiser
places usable premium only where there is exposure (R42).

of.description: For declared items and upcoming events: registered kinds; a parent covers its subtree.

ExposureKind.description:
How a cover finds whom it protects. The engine computes the customer's need differently for
each form; the kinds of items and events are registered in `config/exposure_types.yaml` (R55,
ADR-005).

oneOf.description: A declared item of a registered kind, with its value.
An upcoming event of a registered kind in the policy period, after the waiting period.

Money.description: Money in minor units (cents). No floating point in money paths (R29).

RenewalNotice.description:
R35: the new sums insured, shown `renewal_notice_days` before the period, so the customer can
reallocate, change plan or cancel. `ai::explain` adds one sentence per line (R23).

issue_by.description: The notice must reach the customer by this day.

may_change_plan_or_cancel_without_penalt.description: R42: no plan is named; the customer chooses.

placed_beyond_need.description: Premium the default places beyond what the customer can use now.

update_request.description: Set when the customer is asked to update the allocation in the app or web.

SumInsuredChange.description: One cover's sum insured before and after re-rating.

below_declared_value.description:
R48: losses are paid on a first-loss basis up to the sum insured; the customer is told
when it falls below the declared value.

declared_value.description: The declared value of the insured item, where there is one.

UpdateRequest.description:
The customer is asked to update the allocation; without an update by `respond_by`, the
optimiser's default in this notice applies (R03, R34, R42).

respond_by.description: The last day an update can still apply to this period (R04).

description: The renewal notice with one sentence per change (R35, R23).

issued_on.description:
The day the notice was issued (`ProposeRenewal`, R35); none while it is a preview at
today's rates.

title: RenewalView
